title: Dual-mode switching platform integrating dry fruit detection and leaf screening fruit collection and its operation method
abstract: The present invention discloses an integrated platform of dual-mode switching dry fruit detection and screening and a working method thereof. The platform comprises a frame body, a left detection picking mechanism, a right detection picking mechanism, a left screening leaf collecting fruit mechanism, a right screening leaf collecting fruit mechanism, a conveying mechanism, and a fruit collecting box. According to the present invention, a “phenotype monitoring-comb harvesting” dual-mode collaborative architecture is adopted, and automatic detection of fruit ripeness is achieved via left and right detection picking mechanisms; non-destructive and precise separation of fruit is achieved via a flexible comb brush technique and a dynamic mode switching mechanism; the height and inclination angle of fruit collecting are adaptively adjusted via an umbrella-type electric telescopic rod, thereby effectively avoiding the hybrid of fruit and leaves.

title: Fruit maturity detection device and detection method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a fruit maturity detection device and a detection method thereof, and the fruit maturity detection device comprises a detection rack, wherein a first conveyor belt and a second conveyor belt which are higher and lower are arranged at two sides of the detection rack, the detection rack is respectively provided with an inlet and an outlet facing the first conveyor belt and the second conveyor belt, a detection workbench is obliquely arranged in the detection rack, a rotary detection platform is arranged in the middle of the detection workbench and is horizontally arranged, an object placing platform is arranged on the rotary detection platform and is provided with a plurality of liftable and contractible hardness detectors, a camera support is arranged on the side surface of the detection rack, and a detection camera is arranged on the camera support. The fruit ripeness detection device can be used for detecting the hardness and the chromaticity of fruits by photographing at multiple angles through the hardness detector and the detection camera, achieving an automatic effect by conveying the fruits through the conveying belt, and improving the accuracy of fruit ripeness detection.

title: Visual ripening method, system and device for fruits suitable for transport vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a visual ripening method, a visual ripening system and a visual ripening device for fruits, which are suitable for a transport vehicle, and comprise the steps of acquiring images of target fruits to be ripened in real time through a camera in the transport process of the fruits to acquire target images; determining the ripeness of the target fruit according to the target image and a pre-trained fruit ripeness recognition model, determining target environmental parameters required for ripening the target fruit to the target ripeness according to the ripeness of the target fruit and the pre-trained fruit ripening model, and adjusting working parameters of a carbon dioxide generator, an oxygen generator, an ethylene generator and a temperature control component according to the target environmental parameters so as to catalyze the target fruit to the target ripeness. The ripening condition of fruits can be monitored in real time during fruit transportation through machine vision, and then the ripening agent and the temperature and humidity are controlled, so that the preset ripening degree can be just reached when the fruits are transported to a destination, and the purposes of saving storage and improving fund return efficiency are achieved.

title: Fruit ripening device using ethylene
abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus for ripening fruit using ethylene. More specifically, the apparatus uses ethylene to ripe fruit and can perform post-processes on the fruit by automatically sensing the degree of fruit ripeness or completion of ripening the fruit based on color information of the fruit. The apparatus includes: a housing comprising an outer wall including an insulating material; a chamber which is located inside the housing and accommodates fruit to be ripened; a video module which records images of the fruit to be ripened; an injection nozzle for injecting ethylene in the housing; a control part for controlling the injection amount of ethylene injected through the injection nozzle; and a database (DB) in which reference color information of the fruit is stored. The control part compares color information of the fruit to be ripened recorded by the video module with the reference color information of the data base so as to control the injection amount of ethylene for ripening the fruit.

title: Method for determining harvest target fruit and fruits harvesting device
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for determining a fruit to be harvested and a fruit harvesting apparatus. According to one aspect of the present invention, a fruit harvesting method of the present invention comprises: a step in which an artificial neural network receives a crop image as an input; a step in which the artificial neural network outputs index data related to degree of maturity of each fruit included in the crop image; and a step in which the fruit to be harvested is outputted based on the index data. In the step in which the fruit to be harvested is outputted, a fruit whose labeling data on fruit ripeness included in the index data is higher than a first criterion is output as the fruit to be harvested in a first season. In a second season, the fruit whose labeling data on fruit ripeness included in the index data is higher than a second criterion is output as the fruit to be harvested. The first criterion and the second criterion are different from each other. Accordingly, the apparatus for automatically determining the fruit to be harvested, and the method thereof are provided.

title: Fruit ripening detection method and system based on YOLOv4 model and convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention relates to a fruit ripening detection method and system based on a YOLOv4 model and a convolutional neural network. The method comprises the following steps: step S1, inputting the training picture into a fruit recognition unit based on a YOLOv4 model; step S2, inputting a training data set from the fruit identification unit into the fruit ripening detection unit to train a convolutional neural network-based deep learning model of the fruit ripening detection unit; step S3, shooting pictures through a camera and a raspberry and inputting the pictures into a fruit identification unit; and step S4, inputting the image into a fruit ripening detection unit and outputting whether the fruit ripens. The fruit ripeness detection model is combined on the basis of the YOLOv4 model to detect the ripeness of fruits, and a lightweight YOLOv4-tiny structure is used as an identification network in the YOLOv4 model to improve the accuracy and speed of fruit detection; the fruit maturity detection method can be applied to detection of fruit maturity in daily life so as to facilitate storage of fruits.

title: Fruit ripeness detection and collection system and method thereof
abstract: A fruit ripeness detection and collection system (100) at a fruit bearing tree is provided, the system (100) includes a fruit collection apparatus (103) which includes a plurality of enclosures (105) surrounding a base of the fruit bearing tree which further includes a plurality of filters (109) with decrementally sized holes towards a plurality of chambers (107) in holding detached fruits for each specific fruit bunch for a corresponding chamber, at least one weight sensor (111), wherein the weight sensor (111) is network connectible to a wireless transmitter (113) and a microcontroller (115), wherein data from weight sensor (111) is network connectible to a base station (117), such that notifications of harvest are sent and received.

title: Water-fertilizer integrated management system for orchard planting
abstract: The invention discloses a water and fertilizer integrated management system for orchard planting, which belongs to the technical field of agricultural planting and comprises a control panel and a water and fertilizer integrated module positioned between fruit trees, wherein the water and fertilizer integrated module comprises a pipeline irrigation system, a water and fertilizer pool and a fermentation pool, wherein the water and fertilizer pool and the fermentation pool are communicated with the pipeline irrigation system; through control panel control liquid manure integration module, mix fertilizer and irrigation water with different contents through the liquid manure pond, obtain liquid manure, discharge it through the shower nozzle, make it at the different periods that fruit tree from flowering to fruit ripeness, satisfy the demand of fruit tree to moisture and fertilizer simultaneously, improve the fruit quality.
assignees: TROPICAL CROPS GENETIC RESOURCES INST CATAS

title: Orchard fruit maturity evaluation and picking planning system based on intelligent image analysis
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of fruit image analysis, in particular to an orchard fruit maturity assessment and picking planning system based on intelligent image analysis, which comprises an image acquisition module, an image processing module, a maturity assessment module and a picking planning module, wherein the image acquisition module is used for acquiring fruit ripeness of an orchard; the image acquisition module is used for acquiring image data of fruits in an orchard; the image processing module is used for preprocessing the image data acquired by the image acquisition module, and comprises image enhancement, self-adaptive threshold segmentation and texture direction standardization; the maturity evaluation module is used for analyzing and evaluating the maturity of the fruits by using a deep learning algorithm based on the image data processed by the image processing module to obtain the maturity grade of the fruits; the picking planning module generates a dynamic picking planning scheme according to the evaluation result of the maturity evaluation module, ensures that fruits are picked in the optimal maturity state, and effectively improves the detection precision and reliability of the fruit quality.

title: Orchard fruit maturity evaluation and picking planning system based on intelligent image analysis
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of fruit image analysis, in particular to an orchard fruit maturity assessment and picking planning system based on intelligent image analysis, which comprises an image acquisition module, an image processing module, a maturity assessment module and a picking planning module, wherein the image acquisition module is used for acquiring fruit ripeness of an orchard; the image acquisition module is used for acquiring image data of fruits in an orchard; the image processing module is used for preprocessing the image data acquired by the image acquisition module, and comprises image enhancement, self-adaptive threshold segmentation and texture direction standardization; the maturity evaluation module is used for analyzing and evaluating the maturity of the fruits by using a deep learning algorithm based on the image data processed by the image processing module to obtain the maturity grade of the fruits; the picking planning module generates a dynamic picking planning scheme according to the evaluation result of the maturity evaluation module, ensures that fruits are picked in the optimal maturity state, and effectively improves the detection precision and reliability of the fruit quality.

title: A method for classifying oil palm fruit ripeness
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for classifying oil palm fruit ripeness comprising: preparing oil palm fruitlets (100); characterised in that obtaining Raman spectrum of the oil palm fruit by scanning outer layer of the oil palm fruitlets using Raman spectrometer (200); locating Raman peaks from the obtained Raman spectrum (300); identifying lycopene, -carotene, lutein and neoxanthin representation from the Raman peaks intensity (400); categorizing the oil palm fruitlets as unripe (500); categorizing the oil palm fruitlets as ripe (600); and categorizing the oil palm fruitlets as over-ripe (700). The present invention demonstrates that the Raman spectroscopy is a rapid, reliable and accurate technique for assessing the ripeness of oil palm fruits. Furthermore, this technique is robust against the effects of lighting and noise caused by moisture. The analysis has shown that -carotene, lycopene, lutein and neoxanthin are the carotenoids found in the oil palm fruit skin.

title: Method for calculating fruit maturity
abstract: The invention discloses a fruit maturity calculation method, which comprises the steps of collecting fruit images through an image collecting device in a fruit garden, and detecting fruit positioning by carrying out a convolutional neural network algorithm on the images; intercepting a local fruit picture according to fruit positioning information, and representing pixel points in an HSV (hue, saturation and value) mode by using a conversion formula of RGB (red, green, blue) and HSV (hue, saturation and value); calculating the fruit maturity by calculating the reference value of the fruit color in the positioning frame; calculating the average value of the ripeness of all fruits in the image as the fruit ripeness index of the image; and calculating the nearest neighbor distance of each fruit according to the fruit positioning frame and the size of each fruit positioning frame to calculate the high yield index of the fruit. The invention has the advantages that: the detection speed is high, the generalization performance is high, the portability is strong, the number of network layers can be controlled to be small, and the method is easy to realize.

title: Chlorophyll content measurement method and fruit ripeness determination method
abstract: To provide a chlorophyll content measurement method capable of measuring chlorophyll content exactly with high accuracy, and further a fruit ripeness determination method which has a correlation with an existing color chart of ground colors and can further easily determine the ripeness of the fruit.SOLUTION: A method for measuring a chlorophyll content comprises the steps of (I) irradiating an object with light, (II) detecting at least one light (X) selected from the group consisting of reflected light and scattered light emitted from the inside of the object as light (Y) that is at least three lights having different center wavelengths and whose center wavelength is in the wavelength range of 640 nm or more and 800 nm or less, and (III) calculating the chlorophyll content in the object based on the information on the light (Y). A method for determining fruit ripeness is provided, in which the chlorophyll content in the pericarp is measured and the ripeness of the fruit is determined by the method for measuring the chlorophyll content.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2(a)-(b)
